description: Wave C: Candidate Pipeline - Implement agents 05-11 (Candidate Intake extension, Classification, Placement Manifest, Human Approval with database polling, Placement Executor, Post-Placement Verification). Reuses existing comparator.py for canonical comparison (agent 07). This pipeline takes candidate from intake through approved placement execution.
steps: Extend services/project-ai/app/agents/intake.py execute_intake() to validate candidate package structure, compute file hashes, extract metadata, integrate with block specification from Agent 04. Return AgentResult with outputs: candidate_validation_status, candidate_id, file_hashes

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/classification.py with execute_classification(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Reads CandidateBlockSpecification from prior agent. Classifies into BlockFamily enum using structural features. Returns classification with confidence score and reasoning. Output: block_family, confidence (0.0-1.0), reasoning (string), similar_canonical_blocks (evidence IDs)

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/placement_manifest.py with execute_placement_manifest(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Uses placement/comparator.py CanonicalComparator to compare candidate to canonical blocks (Agent 07 logic). Generates PlacementManifest with PlacementEntry list for each file operation. Computes manifest_hash as SHA-256 of manifest content (JSON sorted keys). Returns AgentResult with outputs: manifest (PlacementManifest), evidence_ids

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/approval.py with execute_approval(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Implements database polling approval workflow. Reads timeout from env var PROJECT_AI_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SEC (default 86400, min 60, max 604800). Creates approval request in database table approval_requests. Polls every 30 seconds for status change. On APPROVED validates manifest_hash matches. On REJECTED or TIMEOUT returns BLOCKED. Returns AgentResult with outputs: approval_status, approved_manifest_hash, reviewer, status BLOCKED until approved per design doc Agent 09 spec

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/placement_executor.py with execute_placement_executor(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Reads approved PlacementManifest from prior agent. Verifies manifest_hash matches approval record. Executes each PlacementEntry: create/update/merge files at target_path. Uses placement/executor.py PlacementExecutor class. Returns AgentResult with outputs: files_created, files_updated, files_skipped, execution_result (PlacementExecutionResult)

Create services/project-ai/app/agents/post_placement_verification.py with execute_post_placement_verification(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult. Uses git diff HEAD to verify placement changes. NO new snapshot generation (snapshot immutability rule). Validates changed files match PlacementManifest entries. Computes file hashes of placed files. Returns AgentResult with outputs: verification_status, changed_files, placed_file_hashes, diff_matches_manifest (boolean) per design doc Agent 11 spec

Create database schema for approval_requests table: request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, manifest_id TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL, requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','TIMEOUT')), reviewer TEXT, reviewed_at TIMESTAMP, comments TEXT. Add migration in services/project-ai/migrations/ or document as SQL file
Create tests/agents/test_classification.py with test cases: test_classification_success, test_high_confidence_match, test_low_confidence_fail, test_multiple_family_candidates
Create tests/agents/test_placement_manifest.py with test cases: test_manifest_generation_success, test_manifest_hash_computation, test_placement_entry_creation, test_evidence_binding
Create tests/agents/test_approval.py with test cases: test_approval_pending, test_approval_approved, test_approval_rejected, test_approval_timeout, test_manifest_hash_mismatch. Mock database polling

Create tests/agents/test_placement_executor.py with test cases: test_execution_success, test_manifest_hash_verification, test_file_create_operation, test_file_update_operation, test_rollback_on_failure
Create tests/agents/test_post_placement_verification.py with test cases: test_verification_success, test_git_diff_parsing, test_manifest_match_validation, test_file_hash_computation
Update tests/agents/test_intake.py to cover extended validation and integration with block specification
Update services/project-ai/app/orchestration/agent_registry.py to register agents: CANDIDATE_CLASSIFICATION, PLACEMENT_MANIFEST, HUMAN_APPROVAL, PLACEMENT_EXECUTOR, POST_PLACEMENT_VERIFICATION
acceptance_criteria: Intake agent extended to validate candidate packages and integrate with block specification
Classification agent determines BlockFamily with confidence scoring
Placement Manifest agent generates complete PlacementManifest with tamper-proof hash using comparator.py
Approval agent implements database polling with configurable timeout, blocks workflow until approved
Placement Executor executes approved manifest with hash verification using executor.py
Post-Placement Verification uses git diff instead of regenerating snapshot
All 6 agent test files created with comprehensive coverage
Agent registry updated with new agents
verification: cd services/project-ai && python -c 'from app.agents.classification import execute_classification; from app.agents.placement_manifest import execute_placement_manifest; from app.agents.approval import execute_approval; from app.agents.placement_executor import execute_placement_executor; from app.agents.post_placement_verification import execute_post_placement_verification; print("All candidate pipeline agents import OK")'
findings: Successfully implemented Wave C candidate pipeline agents (05-11): Extended intake agent with validation, file hashing, and metadata extraction. Created classification agent with BlockFamily detection and confidence scoring. Created placement manifest agent using comparator.py with SHA-256 manifest hash. Created approval agent with database polling, configurable timeout (env var PROJECT_AI_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SEC), and manifest hash verification. Created placement executor agent using executor.py with hash verification. Created post-placement verification agent using git diff without snapshot regeneration. Created approval_requests database schema (migrations/001_approval_requests.sql). All 30 tests pass (5 intake, 5 classification, 5 manifest, 8 approval, 6 executor, 6 verification). Agent registry updated with 6 new agent types. All verification commands pass.
